field.name: athlete_ids
field.label: COM_JUGENDTRAINING_GROUP_ATHLETES
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(lastname, ', ', firstname) AS text FROM #__jt_athletes WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY lastname, firstname

field.name: trainer_user_ids
field.label: COM_JUGENDTRAINING_GROUP_TRAINER_USERS
field.query: SELECT u.id AS value, u.name AS text FROM #__users u INNER JOIN #__user_usergroup_map m ON m.user_id=u.id INNER JOIN #__usergroups g ON g.id=m.group_id WHERE g.title='Jugendtraining - Trainer' ORDER BY u.name
